name: Bloom Profit Analytics
description: Bloom connects Claude to your e-commerce store's profit and sales data. Query real-time revenue, orders, profit margins, and marketing attribution across Shopify and Amazon — including ad spend, ROAS, and per-order costs. Ask questions in plain language and get accurate numbers pulled straight from your live store data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bloom Profit Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bloom Profit Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.bloomanalytics.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bloom Profit Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bloom Profit Analytics provides these MCP tools: list_shops, query_daily_summary, query_order_profits, and query_product_profits.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bloom Profit Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bloom Profit Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Bloom Profit Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bloom Profit Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bloom Profit Analytics is developed by Estore Automate. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
